channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Duarte Júnior após Avante barrar candidatura ao Senado: "Covardes"
item.description: Federal deputy Duarte Júnior (Avante-MA) criticized Avante's veto of his Senate candidacy, calling those responsible 'cowards' and saying they 'messed with the wrong person'. He announced he will run for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies, emphasizing his stance against backroom deals and corruption in Maranhão, with public support and divine blessing.

item.title: Quaest testa disputas eleitorais com pesquisas em cinco estados do Brasil
item.description: Quaest will release five electoral polls between July 29 and 30, covering Bahia, São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Goiás, and Ceará. The surveys will assess voter intention for president, governor, and senator, highlighting the ACM Neto vs. Jerônimo Rodrigues race in Bahia. Releases are split: Bahia and SP on Wednesday, followed by RS, GO, and CE on Thursday.

item.title: PT aciona PGE para apurar quem bancou ida de Javier Milei a convenção do PL
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) has filed a request with Brazil's Electoral General Prosecutor's Office (PGE) to investigate potential irregularities surrounding the participation of Argentine President Javier Milei at the PL party convention that formalized its 2026 presidential candidate. The PT alleges the event may have been illegally funded by foreign interests or undeclared sources, constituting economic power abuse or the use of illicit resources in the electoral campaign. The PGE will assess whether there is evidence of illicit fundraising or violations of Brazilian electoral law.

item.title: Rogéria Bolsonaro deve disputar vaga na Câmara
item.description: Rogéria Bolsonaro, mother of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and former wife of ex-president Jair Bolsonaro, has decided to withdraw from the Senate alternate position on a ticket led by former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União) and will instead run for the Chamber of Deputés under the PL party in Rio de Janeiro. The decision was reported by Veja magazine and communicated to the state PL directory. Her candidacy strengthens the Bolsonaro family's presence in the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Após ter lançado candidata, presidente do DC elogia possível chapa de Romeu Zema com Joaquim Barbosa
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy party (DC), João Caldas, praised the potential ticket of Romeu Zema (Novo) and Joaquim Barbosa (former STF minister) as vice-presidential candidate, highlighting Zema’s readiness and the suitability of the pairing. Although DC had nominated Clariana Barão as its presidential candidate, Caldas indicated the candidacy could change due to ongoing party negotiations, stating 'politics is the art of compromise'. Joaquim Barbosa, who joined DC in May and was initially its pre-candidate, withdrew from the presidential race due to lack of resources, weak party structure, and poor polling numbers.

item.title: Parceria entre TSE e TikTok fortalece a integridade das informações eleitorais
item.description: The TSE and TikTok have signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen electoral information integrity for the 2026 elections, including the creation of an Elections 2026 Information Center on TikTok, electoral labels on related content, and a channel for analyzing complaints. The agreement, valid until December 31, 2026, is free of charge and part of the Permanent Program to Combat Disinformation of the Electoral Justice, aiming to inform voters and counter irregular content.

item.title: Estudo usado por Milei não diz que Brasil liderou 'campanha anti-Argentina'
item.description: The study cited by Javier Milei to accuse Brazil of leading an 'anti-Argentina campaign' does not contain that claim. Milei attended a pre-campaign event for Flávio Bolsonaro in São Paulo, where he also harshly criticized Lula, calling him a 'thief'. The misinformation was amplified by Milei, but the original source does not support his accusation.

item.title: Governo Trump relaciona Bolsonaro em nova ordem contra o Brasil
item.description: The Trump administration renewed the national emergency against Brazil, citing alleged political persecution of former President Jair Bolsonaro, without imposing new sanctions. The measure, published in the Federal Register, extends the 2025 decree that already linked Brazilian government actions to threats to U.S. national security. Bolsonaro is serving house arrest after being sentenced by the STF to 27 years in prison for his role in the January 8 coup attempt.

item.title: Presidente do PT do Recife se licencia de cargo para apoiar Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco
item.description: Osmar Ricardo, president of the PT in Recife, stepped down from his position to support Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) in her re-election bid, citing disagreements with the PT-PSB alliance and candidate João Campos. He criticized the PSB’s influence over the PT in Pernambuco, arguing Campos does not represent the state’s future and that governance favors economic interests over the public. The move comes amid potential dual slates for Lula, who had previously endorsed Campos in a video but avoided an official visit to the state due to internal party tensions.

item.title: Entenda o que é o estado de emergência dos EUA contra o Brasil
item.description: The U.S. government extended its national emergency declaration against Brazil for another year, maintaining the July 2025 declaration without imposing new sanctions. The extension is legally required to prevent automatic expiration and relies on allegations of censorship and arrests by Brazil's Supreme Federal Court, including claims of political persecution against Jair Bolsonaro and his allies.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro acreditam em volta de Magnitsky contra Moraes até eleição
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro believe that U.S. Magnitsky Act sanctions could be reapplied against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes amid rising Brazil-U.S. tensions. This possibility is seen as an effort to pressure the Brazilian judiciary, though no official confirmation of new measures has been made. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: João Campos se agarra a Lula
item.description: Former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) is seeking to strengthen his candidacy for governor of Pernambuco by aligning himself with President Lula (PT), emphasizing the importance of having a governor allied with the federal government. In an interview with Veja, Campos stated that a good relationship with Lula facilitates the articulation of policies and resources for the state.

item.title: João Campos minimiza crescimento de Raquel Lyra em pesquisa Genial/Quaest de Pernambuco: 'Cenário de equilíbrio'
item.description: PSB pre-candidate João Campos downplayed Governor Raquel Lyra’s lead in the latest Genial/Quaest poll, describing the race as a technical tie within the three-point margin of error. He emphasized the importance of President Lula’s support and noted that many voters are still unaware of their alliance, announcing a new campaign phase focused on interior visits. Although Lyra leads with 43% in the first round and 45% in a potential runoff, Campos maintains the race remains balanced.

item.title: O novo projeto político da mãe de Flávio Bolsonaro no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Rogéria Bolsonaro (PL), mother of Flávio and Carlos Bolsonaro, withdrew from the Senate suplency spot on Márcio Canella's (União) ticket and will run for Chamber of Deputies in Rio de Janeiro. The decision was driven by uncertainty over the PL-União-PP alliance in the state, worsened by Canella's arrest in a PF operation over alleged fuel station fund diversions. She is banking on her son Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign to boost her electoral prospects.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Telegram assina acordo com o TSE para coibir condutas ilegais
item.description: Telegram signed a memorandum of understanding with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to combat misinformation in the 2026 elections, including using the API to create an official bot and accessing the Electoral Misinformation Alert System (SIADE).

item.title: João Campos quer reforçar que é o candidato de Lula para reverter desvantagem em pesquisas
item.description: João Campos, former mayor of Recife and PSB candidate for governor of Pernambuco, aims to overturn his polling deficit against incumbent Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) by emphasizing his alignment with President Lula. His campaign seeks to leverage federal political capital to gain ground in the state.

item.title: Em manifestação enviada à PF, defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro nega calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense denied defaming Lula by associating him with Nicolás Maduro, arguing the post only speculated about a possible future mention of Lula in Maduro's testimony. Lawyers stated the phrase 'Lula will be denounced' does not attribute any crime to the president and submitted a written statement to the PF to replace a scheduled virtual hearing. The request was forwarded to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, rapporteur of the investigation into whether the senator committed defamation.

item.title: A resposta de Flávio à Justiça Eleitoral sobre o vídeo de ‘Jair Bolsonaro de IA’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense argued before the TSE that the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention is lawful, as it constitutes internal party propaganda in a closed event with clear disclosure of technological simulation, without intent to deceive. Lawyers compared the episode to the PT's 2018 use of Lula masks when he was ineligible. The case is under the rapporteurship of Minister Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: Republicanos mira em 2030 com Tarcísio de Freitas e não deve fechar aliança com PL
item.description: The Republicans are focusing on 2030, planning to support the re-election of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas as a natural presidential candidate, avoiding an alliance with the PL in 2026. Despite Tarcísio's appearance at Flávio Bolsonaro's convention out of gratitude, the majority of the party rejects supporting Bolsonaro's son and prefers to maintain independence for its long-term presidential project.

item.title: PL vai reforçar segurança de evento com Flávio e Michelle no DF
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) will increase private security for its Distrito Federal convention on August 1st and 2nd due to the expected presence of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for President. The event, held at Parking Lot 11 of Parque da Cidade, is expected to draw at least 7,000 people on Saturday, featuring the official launch of Bia Kicis’s (PL-DF) Senate candidacy and the ratification of PL’s local candidacies for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Direita culpa governo Lula por falta de alianças eleitorais
item.description: The right blames the Lula government for the lack of electoral alliances among four opposition presidential candidacies, claiming pressure on Centrão parties to remain neutral or independent. This includes the União Progressista federation (União Brasil and PP), which chose not to back any presidential candidate, and sectors of Republicanos, whose leader Hugo Motta is expected to support Lula in Paraíba without formally endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro. Opposition allies argue this strategy of 'pure slates' benefits Lula by weakening anti-government coordination.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula vai a unidade odontológica móvel no Rio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits the Mobile Dental Unit at the Federal Hospital of Andaraí in Rio de Janeiro on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, accompanied by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Health Minister Alexandre Padilha. The agenda also includes inspecting a SAMU emergency vehicle and visiting the hospital’s Radiotherapy Center at 3:00 PM.

item.title: Aliado de Zema e governador de Minas há quatro meses, Simões é desconhecido para 58% dos eleitores
item.description: Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) is unknown to 58% of Minas Gerais voters after four months in office, placing fourth in first-round simulations with only 6% voting intention. Despite 30% rating his administration as regular and 28% as positive, he trails Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) by 31 points in a potential runoff and ties with Patrus Ananias (PT) and Alexandre Kalil (PDT). The poll reveals a split on whether Zema deserves to elect a successor, with 46% agreeing and 42% disagreeing.

item.title: EUA vão prorrogar sobretaxa aplicada ao Brasil desde julho de 2025; medida não tem efeito prático
item.description: The U.S. extended by one year the sanctions applied to Brazil since July 2025 under IEEPA, but the measure has no practical effect, as the 40% tariff was struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February 2026. The extension is purely formal, with no new sanctions, serving only as a symbolic gesture that repeats accusations of restrictions on free speech, human rights violations, and political persecution of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Move Brasil: Lula cobra bancos públicos para destravar crédito
item.description: President Lula met with the heads of public banks BB, Caixa, and BNDES to demand faster execution of the Move Brasil program, which finances vehicles for app drivers, taxi drivers, and delivery workers. Despite over 600,000 registrations, only 10,179 contracts were approved by July 14 — just 3.3% of the R$30 billion allocated — with BB leading disbursements. Although the government has adjusted rules (banning registration fees and allowing 2024+ used vehicles), the bottleneck in risk analysis remains, as banks still require down payments and reject proposals despite public guarantees.

item.title: Fundação Cacique Cobra Coral suspende ajuda climática à Argentina
item.description: The Cacique Cobra Coral Foundation announced the suspension of climate assistance to Argentina after Argentine President Javier Milei insulted President Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes during the launch event for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. The foundation labeled the remarks as a 'political attack on our country' and stated Argentina will bear the risk until a formal apology is issued, citing the onset of El Niño.

item.title: Deputado pede à PGR investigação sobre reuniões de Lula no Alvorada
item.description: Federal deputy Sanderson (PL-RS) filed a request with the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate President Lula (PT) for allegedly misusing the Presidency's structure for political-electoral activities, based on a Veja magazine report about meetings at the Palácio do Alvorada. The representation was filed on Monday, April 27.

item.title: Flávio cita máscaras de Lula para rebater ação do PT sobre vídeo de IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense argued before the TSE that the AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention does not constitute anticipatory electoral propaganda or a deepfake, as it clearly states at the outset that it is an artificial simulation. The lawyers contended that the use of Lula masks by supporters during his imprisonment shows that symbolic representations like avatars, effigies, and costumes have long been part of political communication, and that AI merely modernized these tools without implying fraud.

item.title: Saiba quem é a aposta do DC para substituir Barbosa e Rebelo
item.description: Clariana Barão, president of the DC’s state directory in Mato Grosso and a Univag law graduate, was officially nominated as the party’s presidential candidate on July 24, 2026, following the withdrawals of Joaquim Barbosa and Aldo Rebelo. She is the second woman formally confirmed in the 2026 presidential race, alongside Samara Martins of the UP, after her name was approved in a national meeting attended by leaders from 21 state directories. Although she initially favored keeping Barbosa on the ticket for his national profile, she accepted the nomination after internal advocacy by Marco Marrafon and Etevaldo Balbino.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro nega que vídeo por IA do pai seja pedido de voto e diz que respeitou lei eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense denies that the AI-generated video, shown at the PL party convention and simulating a speech by Jair Bolsonaro, constitutes a vote solicitation or electoral law violation, stating that the use of AI was disclosed and the event was limited to party members and guests. The lawyers argue the material is not a deepfake, as it did not intend to deceive, and liken it to traditional campaign props like masks and paper cutouts. The video features Jair Bolsonaro saying he is 'imprisoned and silenced' and urging supporters to embrace Flávio as his chosen successor for the presidency.

item.title: Congresso volta com fila de MPs e pressão sobre pautas de Lula
item.description: The National Congress resumed work in August with a backlog of 32 provisional measures, including INSS retiree reimbursements and the economic response to U.S. tariffs, testing the Lula administration's ability to negotiate and build consensus.

item.title: Negativa de vistos para representantes dos EUA mostra lógica eleitoral pautando decisões de Estado
item.description: The Brazilian government denied entry visas to two U.S. State Department officials, Riley Barnes and Samuel Samson, claiming they would criticize Brazil's electoral system. The move was criticized for mixing electoral rhetoric with state diplomacy, amounting to an inappropriate prior restraint. Analyst Schüler argues Brazil should have upheld transparency and openness, avoiding the instrumentalization of state affairs for political campaigning.

item.title: 'Sempre houve insultos de ambos os lados', diz porta-voz de Milei sobre crise com Lula
item.description: The spokesperson for Argentina's Presidency said that insults have come from both sides in the diplomatic crisis with Brazil, following President Javier Milei's remarks calling Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a 'thief' during the launch of Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy in São Paulo. He emphasized that the conflict was not one-sided, reflecting mutual tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Partido Missão faz congresso e vende ingressos a mais de R$ 7 mil com 'open bar'
item.description: The Mission Party holds its first congress with tickets priced above R$ 7,000, offering open bar and access to party leaders. The event, scheduled for Saturday (1), formalizes Renan Santos’ presidential candidacy, already approved in a virtual convention.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita a Carreta da Saúde da Mulher, no Rio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits the Women's Health Mobile Unit at the Federal Hospital of Andaraí in Rio de Janeiro, accompanied by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Health Minister Alexandre Padilha. The agenda includes stops at the Mobile Dental Unit, a SAMU emergency vehicle, and the hospital’s Radiotherapy Center, emphasizing public health and international cooperation.

item.title: Miss Brasil Julia Gama revela bastidores do ensaio pré-wedding para casamento em Trancoso
item.description: Miss Brazil 2020 Julia Gama shared behind-the-scenes details of her pre-wedding photoshoot at Fazenda Boa Esperança in São Paulo, with fiancé Victor Oliveira. The shoot, photographed by Mayckon Santos, featured three looks by stylist Jeff Ferrari, including a fluid dress by Julia Pak, who will also design her wedding gown. The ceremony is set for September 3 at Teatro L'Occitane in Trancoso, Bahia, with approximately 400 guests.

item.title: Ação por vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro criminaliza o apoio político, diz Flávio ao TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged the TSE to dismiss an urgent injunction against an AI-generated video simulating a speech by Jair Bolsonaro at the PL convention, claiming the action by the Brazil of Hope Federation criminalizes political support. The video, produced using AI, sparked controversy for potentially violating electoral rules on deepfakes.

item.title: PF cancela depoimento de Flávio por calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Federal Police canceled the scheduled testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, PL’s pre-candidate for Presidency, set for Tuesday (July 28, 2026), regarding an inquiry into alleged slander against President Lula for a post comparing him to Nicolás Maduro. Bolsonaro’s defense argues the January 2026 post did not constitute a crime, as it expressed political opinion and repeated U.S. judicial accusations against Maduro, without attributing concrete false facts to Lula.

item.title: Após troca de ofensas do governo com Milei, embaixador brasileiro na Argentina não tem data para voltar ao país vizinho
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, remains in Brasília after being summoned for consultations, with no set date to return to Buenos Aires. The decision depends on the Itamaraty's assessment of the 'evolution of the situation' in bilateral relations, particularly following Argentine President Javier Milei's insults against Lula and Alexandre de Moraes. Meanwhile, the embassy is being led by a chargé d'affaires, reflecting Brazil's diplomatic displeasure.

item.title: A reação de juízes e advogados ao ataque de Milei a Moraes
item.description: Brazilian judges and lawyers defended Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes after Argentine President Javier Milei called him 'bald trash' at the PL convention in São Paulo, labeling the remark an institutional attack on the Judiciary. The associations stressed that legitimate criticism of judicial decisions must be made through legal channels, not personal insults, and emphasized the importance of respecting judicial independence in international relations. The STF shared the statements on its official website.

item.title: IA de Bolsonaro e Milei: Flávio pode ter candidatura cassada, diz jurista
item.description: The use of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro and the participation of Argentine President Javier Milei at the PL convention could constitute electoral abuse of power, according to jurist Márlon Reis, who warns that Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 candidacy may be annulled. The analysis highlights risks from illegal AI use and improper foreign influence in the campaign.

item.title: PL já trabalha com desistência de Cleitinho e pode apoiar Marcelo Aro (PP) ao governo de Minas
item.description: The PL is considering supporting Marcelo Aro (PP) for governor of Minas Gerais after Cleitinho (Republicanos) withdrew his candidacy due to mourning his brother's death. Aro, a former Bolsonaro tourism minister and Zema government secretary, is seen as a more competitive running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro in the state, with potential backing from 11 parties and 60% of radio and TV airtime.

item.title: Mais de 30 deputados argentinos repudiam Milei por ataques a Lula
item.description: Over 30 Argentine deputies signed a document condemning President Javier Milei's attacks on Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, calling the statements 'extremely grave' and warning of damage to bilateral relations and international law. The rebuke followed Milei's appearance at a São Paulo event supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, where he used insults like 'thief', 'convict', and 'bald trash' to describe Brazilian officials.

item.title: Por escrito, Flávio diz à PF que texto sobre Lula foi mal interpretado
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro submitted a written statement to the Federal Police claiming that his January 3 post on X did not constitute the crime of slander against President Lula, arguing the text was misinterpreted: the reference to a possible Lula delation was a generic future prediction, not a false factual accusation, while the list of crimes referred solely to Nicolás Maduro. Lawyers assert there is no criminal intent, concrete offense, or objective elements of the crime of slander under Penal Code Article 138, and request the case be archived due to lack of just cause, alleging political motivation by third parties.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro apresenta esclarecimentos por escrito em inquérito e nega calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro chose not to testify before the Federal Police in the investigation into alleged slander against President Lula and submitted written clarifications to the Supreme Federal Court. His defense argues that the social media post linking Lula to a potential plea bargain by Nicolás Maduro was taken out of context and does not constitute a crime, as mentioning someone in a cooperation agreement does not imply criminal accusation. The inquiry, under Justice Alexandre de Moraes, is examining whether there was an offense against Lula's honor.

item.title: Na campanha do PL o candidato é o de menos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign strategists unveiled two ideas for the PL convention, neither featuring the candidate as a central figure. Both sparked controversy without clarifying the presidential aspirant's policy proposals.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro presta depoimento por escrito e diz que não caluniou Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) submitted a written deposition to the Federal Police, stating that his post about Lula and Nicolás Maduro did not constitute the crime of defamation. He is a pre-candidate for president in 2026 and denies any wrongdoing.

item.title: Aneel abre consulta pública sobre 1º leilão de baterias do Brasil
item.description: Aneel has opened a public consultation for Brazil’s first battery storage auction, scheduled for December 2026, featuring unprecedented rules such as requiring new equipment, banning cross-consortia, and increasing transparency. The auction will consist of two simultaneous tenders: one with a minimum national content requirement and another without. The main point of contention remains who will bear the costs, as a 2025 law stated the expenses would be divided only between...

item.title: Aliados defendem que Flávio faça novo gesto a Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro are urging him to make a new gesture toward Michelle Bolsonaro by attending the PL's Distrito Federal convention, where she will be confirmed as the party's Senate candidate. To avoid the appearance of a forced move, they believe he should meet with her in the coming days. The goal is to smooth their relationship ahead of the event.

item.title: A curiosa justificativa de Flávio para escapar de processo por calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) failed to appear for a Federal Police deposition regarding alleged slander against President Lula, opting instead to submit written explanations. His defense claims that stating Lula 'will be denounced' by Nicolás Maduro does not constitute criminal imputation, as it merely refers to being mentioned in a collaborator’s testimony, and that the second sentence of the post does not refer to Lula. The PF concluded the senator attempted to link Lula to crimes including drug and arms trafficking, money laundering, and support for terrorists, but the PGR supported holding the deposition prior to any potential indictment.
